bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks larger than an A4 sheet are prohibited and must be checked at the cloakroom. Small bags like fanny packs, purses, and clutches are allowed.
allowed: small bags equivalent to an A4 sheet
prohibited: backpacks larger than an A4 sheet
any other objects that could be used as weapons
bagPolicy.note: Exceptions for food may apply; please contact the venue.

parking.note: Unipol Arena offers parking for 5000 cars and has reserved spaces for disabled people. Accredited disabled users can access free parking via a separate entrance.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Unipol Arena's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and drinks are heavily restricted inside the arena. Only plastic bottles up to 0.5 liters without caps are allowed, and bringing in any kind of food is prohibited unless exceptions are made by contacting the venue.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Unipol Arena, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Unipol Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Unipol Arena. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Unipol Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
